title: Without You
hook: Rumi wrote one line that Iranians still sing, nearly eight hundred years later.

segments.fa: بی‌همگان به سر شود، بی‌تو به سر نمی‌شود
segments.en: Without everyone else, life goes on. Without you, it does not.

segments.fa: داغ تو دارد این دلم، جای دگر نمی‌شود
segments.en: My heart bears your brand. It can belong nowhere else.

tafsir: The word dagh means a brand, the mark burned on what belongs to someone.
Rumi says his heart is marked. It cannot be given elsewhere.
Who is this you? For Rumi, the divine Beloved, glimpsed through Shams.
This week in our serial, Shams leaves Konya.
This is what that absence sounds like.

outro.say: Shams and Rumi, the serial, is on our page. Follow The Guest House.
